title: Sort log entries by timestamp
brief: Sort these log lines alphabetically by their timestamp prefix (first 19 chars).
text:
2026-11-12 09:15:23 ERROR disk full
2026-11-12 08:30:01 INFO startup complete
2026-11-12 10:45:12 WARN memory low
2026-11-12 07:00:00 DEBUG init started

expect.text:
2026-11-12 07:00:00 DEBUG init started
2026-11-12 08:30:01 INFO startup complete
2026-11-12 09:15:23 ERROR disk full
2026-11-12 10:45:12 WARN memory low

why: The :sort command sorts lines lexicographically, which works perfectly for ISO timestamps.
author: claude (daily)
